summary: The 'LanguageSwitcher' is a user control that allows toggling between different language locales on a webpage. It modifies the URL's locale parameter to switch between default and alternative locales.
purpose: To provide the functionality of switching between different language locales on a webpage by modifying the URL parameters.

fields.name: UserSession
fields.description: HSPnetSession object holding user's session data including locale information.

fields.name: lbLanguageSwitcher
fields.description: LinkButton used to trigger the language switch event.

actors.name: User
actors.description: A user interacting with the language switcher control to change the language of the webpage.

workflows.name: Language Locale Switching
steps: The current URL and locale parameter are retrieved.
If locale parameter is absent, it is appended with the current UserSession locale.
Locale is toggled between default and alternative settings.
If applicable, URL hash is added.
Page is redirected to the new URL.

business_rules: Locale parameter should be appended to the URL if not present.
Locale is toggled between default and alternative values.
conditions: If no locale parameter is present, use UserSession's current locale.
Toggle from default to alternative locale based on UserSession's `IsUsingDefaultLocale`.
system_behavior: Redirects the user to a URL with the updated locale parameter.
